newsitem.title: USA: Pioneer board removes CEO, COO.
newsitem.headline: Pioneer board removes CEO, COO.

text.p: Pioneer Commercial Funding Corp said Monday that Chief Executive Arthur Goldberg and Chief Operating Officer Elie Housman have been removed from their posts by the board of directors.
The company said M. Albert Nissim has been appointed president and chief executive. A new chief operating officer was not immediately named.
The board removed Goldberg and Housman at a meeting on January 9, it said.

Nissim is an officer of ICTS International NV, a company headquartered in Holland that provides enhanced security to the aviation industry. Nissim also is a director of Tuffy Associates Corp, a franchiser of auto parts shops in the Midwest.
Pioneer did not immediately return a telephone call seeking further comment.
Nissim said in an interview later Monday that the two officers were removed largely because "the stock has not performed well. I mean to try to turn it around a bit."
He said there were no immediately plans to name a new chief operating officer.
((-- Lisa Marie Pane, New York newsdesk))
